house.description: Minnesota State High School League members required to allow broadcast over public access channels.

House.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to Education Policy

bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to education; requiring Minnesota State High School League members to allow broadcast over public access channels; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 128C.02, by adding a subdivision.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 128C.02, is amended by adding a subdivision to read:

[+Subd. 10.+]

[+Video production.+]

[+The league must adopt a policy requiring members to allow live and recorded video production of all competitions in extracurricular activities for distribution by public, educational, or governmental access channels operating under chapter 238. The policy may not impair a preexisting contract in effect at the time the policy is adopted. +]

[+EFFECTIVE DATE.+]

[+This section is effective the day following final enactment. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to education; requiring Minnesota State High School League members to allow broadcast over public access channels; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 128C.02, by adding a subdivision.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 128C.02, is amended by adding a subdivision to read:

Subd. 10.

Video production.

The league must adopt a policy requiring members to allow live and recorded video production of all competitions in extracurricular activities for distribution by public, educational, or governmental access channels operating under chapter 238. The policy may not impair a preexisting contract in effect at the time the policy is adopted.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective the day following final enactment.
additions: The league must adopt a policy requiring members to allow live and recorded video production of all competitions in extracurricular activities for distribution by public, educational, or governmental access channels operating under chapter 238. The policy may not impair a preexisting contract in effect at the time the policy is adopted.
This section is effective the day following final enactment.
